title: The math behind the OpenAI Jalapeño chip
summary: OpenAI developed a custom ASIC chip called Jalapeño in partnership with Broadcom to reduce dependency on expensive third-party hardware like Nvidia GPUs. The chip aims to lower the massive capital expenditure required for AI inference operations, where Nvidia currently enjoys approximately 75% profit margins on their hardware.
problem_solved: Reduces the astronomical infrastructure costs associated with running AI inference at scale on third-party hardware, particularly Nvidia GPUs.
why_valuable: Custom chips like Jalapeño could dramatically reduce per-inference costs and give OpenAI better control over their infrastructure economics, potentially accelerating their path to profitability.
